sources.title: Lesson #1: Warm Up Session Lvl.1 (Bass Exercise)
sources.why: A slow warm-up walked up and down the neck with the camera on the fretting hand: position changes with solo bass audio.

sources.title: (Only Metronome) Warm up & Basic Chromatic exercise w/ tabs (2)
sources.why: A deliberately slow chromatic exercise with metronome and bass only: every semitone, clean pitch labels.

sources.title: (Only Metronome) C Major Scale Exercise with tabs
sources.why: A short C major scale from the same player and setup, for more of that player's positions.

sources.title: 19-02 - A - Bass Technique - Fluency Exercise #1
sources.why: A fretting-hand fluency drill from a second player and camera.

sources.title: 21-07 - A - Finger Exercise in G major (slow & fast)
sources.why: The same exercise at two tempi: whether the fret-position features hold when the hand moves fast.

sources.title: 20-01-B Finger Independence Exercise
sources.why: An arpeggio drill with the index anchored: several frets under one hand position.

sources.title: 8. Finger Combinations Exercise - Closeup
sources.why: A close-up on the fretting hand alone: the framing that gave the guitar model its best detection.
sources.notes: Only one hand in frame; the positional pick accepts a lone hand on the chosen half.

sources.title: Bass Warm up Exercise on E string (Chromatic Scale)
sources.why: A chromatic scale on one string: pitch changes with position only, the cleanest test of the along-the-neck feature.
sources.notes: 720p, a 2012 upload; kept for the one-string design, dropped if detection is poor.

sources.title: Tricky Finger Exercise - "Close to the Edge"
sources.why: The longest solo clip found (eight minutes) from a fifth player.

sources.title: JF Bass Gym - Ex.23 - Finger Independence Drill
sources.why: 4K footage of a groove drill; only the opening solo section before the backing track joins is usable.
